snippet.title: Solbrand — Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Gritty oceanpunk meets norse mysticism in this archaeological puzzle adventure set in reimagined Uppsala, Sweden. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and untangle a knot of cosmic proportions: Why is the sun so loud?

Wishlist now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3772990/

Presskit and Developer info:
https://www.deadpeopledreaming.com

Follow development on Discord:
